core: Axial mesoderm and neural plate morphogenesis
name: Axial mesoderm, notochord and neural plate morphogenesis
rationale: Members cover axial mesoderm/notochord formation, floor plate and neural plate morphogenesis along the body axis; unlike the spinal cord patterning and neural plate border confusables, the theme includes notochord, convergent extension and paraxial mesoderm formation.

name: Lateral plate mesoderm and hindgut morphogenesis
rationale: Members concern lateral plate mesoderm formation, mesenchyme migration and hindgut/digestive tract morphogenesis, whereas confusables cover gastrulation, primitive streak and cardiac mesoderm.

name: Prostate gland and reproductive tract morphogenesis
rationale: All members describe development of the prostate, genitalia and Mullerian tract organs (oviduct, uterus, vagina); this separates the theme from salivary/mammary branching and gonadal sex-determination confusables.

name: Histone mRNA 3'-end processing and mRNA nuclear export
rationale: Members cover replication-dependent histone pre-mRNA stem-loop processing, Pol II termination and nuclear export of mature mRNAs; the histone/SLBP processing distinguishes it from export-only and polyadenylation confusables.

core: Vascular wall smooth muscle and endothelium
name: Vascular smooth muscle and endothelial shear stress response
rationale: Members span SRF-driven smooth muscle contractile/actin programmes, aortic smooth muscle development and endothelial responses to laminar and oscillatory shear; the shear stress and aorta development members separate it from smooth muscle phenotypic switching confusables.

name: Nucleotide sugar synthesis, transport and GPI anchoring
rationale: Members cover hexosamine/UDP-GlcNAc and CMP-sialic acid synthesis, SLC35 nucleotide-sugar transporter defects and GPI anchor synthesis; the transport and GPI members distinguish it from N-/O-glycan and glycosphingolipid confusables.

name: HIV-1 replication cycle with reverse transcription and integration
rationale: All members are HIV-1 life cycle steps (entry, uncoating, reverse transcription, nuclear import, integration, Rev export, Env/Vpu); reverse transcription and integration distinguish it from other-virus and host retroelement restriction confusables.

name: Axon growth, sprouting and regeneration with Sema3A repulsion
rationale: Members concern axon extension, collateral sprouting, regeneration and Sema3A/RHOA growth inhibition; regeneration and sprouting members distinguish it from netrin, slit and ephrin guidance confusables.

name: Mitotic spindle, centrosome maturation and contractile ring cytokinesis
rationale: Members cover spindle assembly and checkpoint, Aurora A/PLK1-driven centrosome maturation and actomyosin ring cytokinesis; centrosome maturation and furrow members separate it from chromosome condensation, nuclear envelope and spindle orientation confusables.

name: Male sex determination and somatic testis differentiation
rationale: Members cover male sex determination, testis differentiation, Leydig cells, AMH signalling and gonadal mesoderm; confusables instead concern germ cells, Sertoli proliferation, ovarian cycles or genital tract morphogenesis.

name: Type I interferon antiviral effectors and signalling regulation
rationale: Members describe the IFN-alpha/beta response with ISG15, OAS and PKR effectors and negative regulation of IFN signalling; the effector and regulatory members distinguish it from viral sensing and IFN signature confusables.

name: Trans-synaptic adhesion, synapse assembly and dendrite morphogenesis
rationale: Members cover neurexin/neuroligin adhesion, receptor clustering, pre/postsynaptic assembly and dendrite/spine morphogenesis; adhesion and assembly members distinguish it from glutamate receptor activation, LTP and vesicle-recycling confusables.

name: Chemokine signalling in dendritic cell and lymphocyte migration
rationale: Members cover chemokine-receptor binding, leukocyte homing and dendritic cell maturation and chemotaxis, with Cdc42/PLC signalling distinguishing it from monocyte, NK and integrin migration confusables.

name: TRIF-dependent TLR3 and TLR4 signalling and cell death
rationale: Members describe TICAM1/TRIF signalling from TLR3/TLR4 to TAK1/RIP1 and programmed cell death; this separates it from MyD88/IRAK, TLR7/8/9 and IRF3 activation confusables.

qualifier: calcineurin-NFAT control, hypertrophy, atrophy and fibre type
name: Calcineurin-NFAT control of striated muscle hypertrophy, atrophy and fibre type
rationale: Members cover cardiac and skeletal muscle adaptation (hypertrophy, atrophy, fast/slow fibre transition) with calcineurin-NFAT regulation, which distinguishes it from cell size and muscle growth confusables.

name: Golgi-endosome vesicle traffic and COPI-independent retrograde transport
rationale: Members cover bidirectional Golgi-endosome transport, Golgi retention and COPI-independent Golgi-to-ER traffic, distinguishing it from COPI, lysosome biogenesis and endocytic recycling confusables.

name: Epidermal keratinocyte differentiation and ectodermal appendage development
rationale: Members span keratinocyte differentiation and cornification plus hair, tooth, nail and gland appendage development (including ectodermal dysplasia); this separates it from junction, pigmentation and intestinal epithelium confusables.

name: Regulation of endosomal TLR7/8/9 and cGAS-STING nucleic acid sensing
rationale: Members regulate endosomal TLR7/8/9 and cGAS-STING signalling and IFN-beta output; the cGAS-STING members distinguish it from RNA editing, TLR3 deficiency and IRF7 activation confusables.

name: Neutrophil degranulation and complement receptor signalling in myeloid inflammation
rationale: Members describe myeloid/neutrophil inflammatory activation, degranulation and complement receptor signalling, distinguishing it from formyl peptide chemotaxis and myeloid identity confusables.

name: Stress granule dynamics and ARE-binding protein mRNA destabilization
rationale: Members cover stress granule assembly/disassembly, PKR and arsenite stress and TTP/BRF1/KSRP-mediated mRNA decay; stress granules separate it from AUF1/HuR ARE confusables and ARE decay from heat shock and proteolysis confusables.

name: Nucleoside and xenobiotic drug transmembrane transport
rationale: Members cover nucleoside/nucleobase transporters (including SLC29A3), nucleoside-analogue drug transport and xenobiotic export; transport distinguishes it from nucleotide catabolism and thiopurine metabolism confusables.

name: Endocardial cushion EMT, heart valve and septum morphogenesis
rationale: Members describe endocardial cushion EMT and fusion forming cardiac valves and septa, distinguishing it from ventricular myocardium and heart field confusables.

name: Transsulfuration and sulfide oxidation in sulfur amino acid catabolism
rationale: Members cover transsulfuration of homocysteine to cysteine, cysteine catabolism and H2S oxidation to sulfate, distinguishing it from selenium, glutathione and choline/carnitine confusables.

name: Cadherin adherens junction assembly and TGF-beta-driven EMT
rationale: Members concern calcium-dependent cadherin adhesion and adherens/apical junction assembly, with TGF-beta EMT signalling and junction assembly separating it from CDH1 degradation, CDH11 and polarity confusables.

qualifier: fructose, galactose, pentose and intestinal hexose absorption
name: Fructose, galactose and pentose metabolism with intestinal hexose absorption
rationale: Members cover fructose, galactose (Leloir), pentose/xylulose and non-oxidative PPP metabolism plus dietary carbohydrate digestion and hexose transport, distinguishing it from glycolysis, gluconeogenesis and glycogen confusables.
